system.description:
Time and effort spent mastering the culinary arts has paid off.

  • You become familiar with most common ingredients and dishes.

  • You can prepare an enjoyable meal, provided you have the time, tools, and ingredients.

  • When you take a Long Rest, you may spend some time preparing a meal for yourself and any companions. Anyone who eats it may choose to gain Advantage on a single check they make before the next time they take a Long Rest.
